paper_title: Limits from the FUNK Experiment on the Mixing Strength of Hidden-Photon Dark Matter in the Visible and Near-Ultraviolet Wavelength Range
notes: FUNK dish-antenna search for hidden-photon dark matter. Mass-resolved 95% C.L. exclusion on kinetic mixing chi taken directly from Table III (Appendix A), which tabulates chi/10^-13 vs m_gamma'/eV; values reported here as chi = table_value x 1e-13. Same curve shown as the red line in Fig. 23/24. Best limit chi ~ 6.65e-13 near m ~ 3.3 eV; headline range 1.95-8.55 eV (quoted competitive limit 2.5-7 eV, chi ~ 1e-12). Assumes hidden photons are all of the cold DM at rho_CDM = 0.3 GeV/cm^3 (Eq. 10). No density rescaling applied per task card. Note the endpoint values at 1.95 eV (2.45e-11) and 8.55 eV (7.41e-12) are the weak edges of the sensitivity band.
